title: Heart rate and breathing
summary: The heart rate rises as you breathe in and falls as you breathe out.
description: An ECG and breathing in a healthy 23-year-old woman, lying still and awake. Switch on the heart-rate channel: the rate rises as she breathes in (the breathing trace rises) and falls as she breathes out. This respiratory sinus arrhythmia comes mostly from changes, with each breath, in the activity of the vagus nerves to the sinoatrial node.
look_for: The heart rate at the top and at the bottom of each breath
How many breaths a minute she takes
That the R–R interval is shorter during inspiration

channels.name: Breathing
channels.about: the breathing trace rises as she breathes in

beats.note: Each beat was found automatically and then checked by eye (the beats of the Fantasia database).

subject.notes: A healthy volunteer, lying down and watching the film Fantasia to stay awake, as the database records.
